description: Stations d'épuration localisées ponctuellement dans le Jura is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.application.i2. Couche réalisée le 15/02/2018 par Atelier SIG d'après les données SEREF (David Cellier) Date des données: 2017 Localisation sur la commune des stations d'épuration, des décanteurs digesteurs (avec leur capacité, leur conformité....). Coverage: FR. Its keywords include données ouvertes. The listing shows 2018-05-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
